account_and_path.priority: Earlier causal fill timestamp, then larger displacement z, deeper OTE, larger target-to-stop ratio, lexical candidate id.
account_and_path.top_winner_removal: Remove the largest ceiling(10%) positive 12bp trade ids from the initial route and rerun the global slot from the beginning.

distinct_scope: No BPR overlap, FVG/IFVG requirement, breaker/order-block state, session/kill-zone filter, cross-asset SMT, OI, options, L2 cancellation, liquidation or OCO payoff. Entry is the frozen Fibonacci retracement of the raid-to-MSS dealing range.

information_contract.bars: Completed 5s or 15s trade-derived OHLC and aggressive quote-notional flow only.
information_contract.entry_activation: The OTE limit is active from the first bar after completed MSS confirmation.
information_contract.fill: Require an actual trade-through by at least one observed tick beyond the OTE level; mere touch does not fill.
information_contract.position_exit: Structural stop or frozen opposite-liquidity target only; no elapsed-time liquidation.
information_contract.pre_entry_invalidation: Cancel if the structural stop is breached or the frozen target is reached before fill.
information_contract.rolling_state: Volatility, internal structure and external liquidity end before the raid; the raid and MSS bars are excluded from their own baselines.
information_contract.source_boundary: An unresolved filled position at a non-contiguous sample boundary is charged its full structural stop plus cost.

market.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

promotion_boundary.if_development_survives: Expand unchanged on additional pre-2024 dates, add exact Bybit funding and executable BBO/queue audit, then freeze before 2024.
promotion_boundary.if_fit_survivor_but_development_fails: Retire selected dependency and do not open 2024.
promotion_boundary.if_zero_fit_survivors: Retire exact sweep-MSS-OTE dependency; do not tune adjacent Fibonacci levels.

purpose: Fatal pre-2024 test of a causal SMC/ICT liquidity-sweep, market-structure-shift and Optimal Trade Entry retracement model on Bybit USDT perpetual public trades.

smc_ict_translation.dealing_range: Bullish: raid low to MSS close; bearish: raid high to MSS close.
smc_ict_translation.displacement: The raid-extreme to MSS-close move is at least 2 or 3 prior-volatility units and its cumulative aggressive quote-notional flow is aligned by at least 0.45 or 0.65.
smc_ict_translation.draw_on_liquidity: The opposite external-liquidity extreme frozen at MSS confirmation.
smc_ict_translation.external_liquidity: Prior completed 300s or 900s high/low; frozen before the raid.
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_raid: A completed 5s/15s bar trades through the frozen external extreme and closes back inside it.
smc_ict_translation.market_structure_shift: Within 3 or 6 completed bars after the raid, price closes through the frozen prior 60s/180s internal extreme in the reversal direction.
smc_ict_translation.optimal_trade_entry: A resting entry at 62%, 70.5% or 79% retracement of the frozen dealing range, active only after the MSS bar completes.
smc_ict_translation.stop: One observed tick beyond the liquidity-raid extreme.
